meetnetten_identity_contract.source_database_identity: both publisher SQL views derive locationID from the same dbo.DimLocation LocationID

chorus.target_adult_index_candidate: maximum adult male individualCount across valid chorus visits within locationID x species x year
chorus.explicit_absence_rule: zero is permitted only when a target-species occurrence row is explicitly occurrenceStatus=absent; missing row is not zero

larvae_metamorph.larval_index_candidate: larval individualCount with number_of_sweeps retained as observation effort
larvae_metamorph.metamorph_index_candidate: metamorph individualCount analysed only if raw positive and effort coverage passes the estimability gate
larvae_metamorph.explicit_absence_rule: zero is not upgraded to true reproductive failure; it remains an observed zero under the declared sampling effort

ecological_target.main_question: when does adult breeding effort cease to translate into downstream larval or metamorph production?
ecological_target.primary_candidate_estimand: species-specific slope linking adult chorus index to downstream stage abundance at exact shared location-year
ecological_target.decoupling_definition: environment-dependent weakening of the adult-breeding to downstream-stage relationship, not simple adult presence with a downstream zero
ecological_target.reason: larvae/metamorphs are downstream reproductive output but are not automatically recruits to the adult population

PINK.role: within-programme repeated adult-call egg larva validation

raw_overlap_gate.note: these are structural estimability screens, not power thresholds and not evidence for ecological effects

prior_art_boundary.citation: Greenberg CH, Zarnoch SJ, Austin JD. 2017. Ecosphere 8:e01789. DOI 10.1002/ecs2.1789
prior_art_boundary.cannot_claim: first demonstration that breeding effort and recruitment/reproductive output can decouple
prior_art_boundary.target_novelty: localize the bottleneck to a declared life-stage transition and test whether environmental context changes conversion of breeding effort into downstream production across independent monitoring programmes
